sentences.text: Det er vinter i Bergen. Det er kaldt, og det er snø i fjellet.
sentences.english: It is winter in Bergen. It is cold, and there is snow in the mountains.

sentences.text: Anna og Lars har ei hytte i fjellet. De drar til hytta hver vinter.
sentences.english: Anna and Lars have a cabin in the mountains. They go to the cabin every winter.

sentences.text: I år skal Sam dra med dem. Nils og Marta skal ikke dra.
sentences.english: This year Sam is going with them. Nils and Marta are not going.

sentences.text: Hva gjør vi på hytta?
sentences.english: What do we do at the cabin?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Vi går på ski. Vi sover, og vi spiser mat.
sentences.english: We ski. We sleep, and we eat food.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg kan ikke gå på ski.
sentences.english: I cannot ski.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Det er ikke vanskelig. Hvis du går hver dag, går du bra.
sentences.english: It is not difficult. If you ski every day, you will ski well.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: De tok bussen, og så gikk de lenge i snøen.
sentences.english: They took the bus, and then they walked for a long time in the snow.

sentences.text: Da de kom til hytta, var det kaldt.
sentences.english: When they came to the cabin, it was cold.

sentences.text: Vi trenger peisen!
sentences.english: We need the fireplace!
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Peisen ble varm. De satt i stua og var glade.
sentences.english: The fireplace became warm. They sat in the living room and were happy.

sentences.text: Anna laget middag. De spiste suppe og brød, og de drakk te.
sentences.english: Anna made dinner. They ate soup and bread, and they drank tea.

sentences.text: Peisen er bra. Jeg liker stua.
sentences.english: The fireplace is good. I like the living room.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Etter middagen satt de lenge og snakket om Norge, om fjellet og om familien.
sentences.english: After dinner they sat and talked for a long time about Norway, about the mountains and about the family.

sentences.text: Er du trøtt, Sam?
sentences.english: Are you tired, Sam?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, men jeg er glad. Vi sover snart.
sentences.english: Yes, but I am happy. We will sleep soon.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Dagen etter var det sol. Sam tok skiene, og de gikk ut.
sentences.english: The next day there was sun. Sam took the skis, and they went out.

sentences.text: Sam var ikke bra på ski, men Lars hjalp ham.
sentences.english: Sam was not good at skiing, but Lars helped him.

sentences.text: Det er vanskelig! Men jeg liker snøen.
sentences.english: It is difficult! But I like the snow.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Du går bra nå. Du kan dra til hytta hver vinter!
sentences.english: You are skiing well now. You can go to the cabin every winter!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Om kvelden satt de i stua igjen. Sam var trøtt, men han var glad.
sentences.english: In the evening they sat in the living room again. Sam was tired, but he was happy.

sentences.text: Anna har bursdag i vinter. Lars har en gave, og Sam lager kake. Alle gratulerer henne.
sentences.english: Anna has a birthday in winter. Lars has a gift, and Sam makes a cake. Everyone congratulates her.

sentences.text: Før turen til hytta pakket vi. Vennene mine pakket jakker. Det var en ny reise for meg.
sentences.english: Before the trip to the cabin we packed. My friends packed jackets. It was a new journey for me.

sentences.text: Hvis jeg ikke forstår, kan jeg spørre. Det er vanskelig å gå på ski, men ikke når Anna hjelper.
sentences.english: If I do not understand, I can ask. It is difficult to ski, but not when Anna helps.
sentences.speaker: sam
